kashika: निर्दिष्टग्रहणमनुवर्तते। तस्मादिति पञ्चम्यर्थनिर्देश उत्तरस्यैव कार्यं भवति, न पूर्वस्य। <<तिङ्ङतिङः>> [[८.१.२८]] — ओ॒द॒नं प॑चति। इह न भवति — पच॑त्यो॒दनम् इति॥
kashikaEnglish: When a rule says 'after that' (तस्मात्), the operation applies to what follows.
englishShort: The words in the पञ्चमी विभक्ति are used to indicate that the कार्य happens on an immediately next entity.
englishFull:
A term in the ablative case indicates the operation affects what immediately follows it.

As locative refers to preceding, ablative refers to succeeding.

**Example:** @ref[8.4.61] — "After उद्, स्थ/स्तम्भ् assimilate."
उद् + स्थानम् → उत्थानम् (the स् following उद् becomes थ्)

**Example:** @ref[8.2.18] तिङ् ङतिङः — "A tiṅ-ending word after a non-tiṅ word becomes anudātta."
ओदनं पचति — पचति (following ओदनम्) becomes anudātta.
But not पचत्योदनम् — here ओदनम् follows.
